core_prompt: Annotate the next native partner turn after a fixed replacement. This is a MODEL JUDGMENT, not human truth. Input includes the preceding agent request, replaced executed partner block, and up to four independent suffixes with intervening agent messages/tool results and the next executed partner block. For each suffix return JSON {"relations":[{"rep":0,"relation":"continues"|"neutral"|"contradicts_or_undoes","reason":"brief"},...]}. Judge the salient action/reporting behavior rather than surface words. Continues: sustains the same distinctive compliance/partialness/withholding/uncertainty or cooperation style when comparable. Contradicts_or_undoes: materially reverses a report/action or repairs the same branch behavior (e.g. executes an action previously skipped, clarifies an initially vague report), even if an intervening request elicits the repair. Neutral: new topic, terminal token, no comparable behavior, or ordinary progress without reversal. Do not call ordinary changed device state caused by explicit new instructions a contradiction. Do not infer causality, success, or intention beyond evidence. Output exactly one row per supplied suffix; no rows for absent next turns.
